title: Raving Goblinmaster
summary: Chase the goblinmaster through timed goblin waves before challenging his final form.
overview: Chase the goblinmaster through timed goblin waves before challenging his final form.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Finish each wave quickly and move together to the next stage.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: At the required berserker quest stage, say 'ready' to begin the chase.
Defeat three waves of five frantic goblins, then three ferocious goblins. Each wave has a one-minute failure deadline.
The goblinmaster moves onward between waves, so keep track of his route while clearing the current group.
Completing the final wave spawns the hostile goblinmaster. His ten-minute idle timer pauses in combat.

notes: Approval E402. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
